meta.description: Guided statistical analysis for research data - test selection, assumption checking, effect sizes, power analysis, Bayesian alternatives, and APA-formatted reporting. Use whenever a user wants to compare groups, test a hypothesis, analyze experimental or survey data, check statistical assumptions, compute required sample sizes, or write up results - even if they never name a specific test. Covers t-tests, ANOVA, chi-square, correlation, regression, non-parametric and Bayesian methods. For low-level model APIs, see the statsmodels and pymc skills.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication; documentation promotes rigorous statistical practice with emphasis on pre-registration, assumption checking, and honest reporting

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for statistical analysis; excellent boundaries directing low-level APIs to statsmodels and pymc skills; strong emphasis on statistical integrity

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established statistical methodology with proper emphasis on effect sizes, power analysis, and APA reporting standards

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper imports; version-specific API changes (pingouin 0.6, ArviZ 1.x) clearly documented

functional_suitability.note: Exceptional coverage including test selection, assumption checking, effect sizes, power analysis, Bayesian methods, and reporting with comprehensive bundled scripts and reference files

recommendations.title: Strengthen post-hoc power criticism
recommendations.problem: Post-hoc power identified as misleading but critique could be stronger
recommendations.root_cause: Users frequently request observed power despite it being uninformative
recommendations.fix: Add explicit warning: 'Post-hoc/observed power is mathematically redundant with the p-value and provides no additional information. If p < 0.05, observed power appears high; if p > 0.05, it appears low. This is circular reasoning. Use sensitivity analysis instead to determine what effect the study could have detected.'

recommendations.title: Add quick decision flowchart for test selection
recommendations.problem: Test selection guidance is comprehensive but users may need visual decision tree
recommendations.root_cause: Quick reference table is excellent but visual flowchart aids rapid decision-making
recommendations.fix: Add flowchart: 'Start → How many groups? → 2: Independent or paired? → Independent: Normal? → Yes: t-test, No: Mann-Whitney' etc.

recommendations.title: Add output format specifications for test result objects
recommendations.problem: Result extraction shown but not comprehensive output structure documentation
recommendations.root_cause: Users may need to access additional columns not shown in examples
recommendations.fix: Add note: 'Pingouin test functions return DataFrames. Common columns: T/F/U/W (test statistic), dof, p_val, cohen_d/hedges (effect size), CI95 (confidence interval), power. Use .columns to see all available fields.'
